problem.h2: Your project needs more than generic code suggestions

items.title: TYPO3 conventions
items.body: TCA, FlexForms, extension testing and DDEV follow their own conventions. Stack-specific skills collect the relevant guidance.

items.title: Security and releases
items.body: Supply-chain checks, SBOMs and signed releases need deliberate setup. The catalog links to the skills and source documentation for these tasks.

items.title: Team workflows
items.body: Concourse pipelines, Matrix communication and Jira work each have their own tools, access requirements and review steps.

stats.platformsLabel: agents supported by the skills CLI

improvementLoop.lead: These packages help maintain other skills. Harness checks repository instructions and enforcement, Assessment evaluates published checkpoints, and Retro proposes changes from observed friction. Companion skills cover authoring and installation.

nodes.title: Harness
nodes.body: Verifies AGENTS.md, linked documentation and enforcement, then identifies or creates missing infrastructure.

nodes.title: Assessment
nodes.body: Combines mechanical checks with LLM-assisted reviews for skills whose checkpoints match the project.

nodes.title: Retro
nodes.body: Examines session friction and proposes concrete changes to memory, project rules, skills or checkpoints. Applying a proposal requires approval.

improvementLoop.loopBack: Approved Retro proposals can improve Harness rules, Assessment checkpoints and other skills.
improvementLoop.companionsLead: Authoring skills prepare instructions and checkpoints; host tools make skills available in PHP and Node projects.

companions.title: agent-rules
companions.body: Extracts project commands, architecture and conventions into AGENTS.md and related rule files.

companions.title: add-checkpoints
companions.body: A separate skill shipped with automated-assessment. Adds checkpoints that Assessment can evaluate; select it separately with a skill-only installer.

companions.title: skill-repo
companions.body: Provides templates and validation for manifests, split licensing and release workflows.

companions.title: composer-agent-skill-plugin
companions.body: Discovers trusted skill packages or direct sources and registers their instructions in AGENTS.md.

companions.title: node-agent-skill-coordinator
companions.body: Discovers skills from npm dependencies and registers them in the project's AGENTS.md.

story.body1: Netresearch DTT GmbH develops and publishes Agent Skills for TYPO3, software engineering and team workflows. Each entry links to the repository that maintains its instructions and tools.
story.body2: The source README describes the package. Requirements, executable tools and installer support vary; check them before using a skill in your project.

openStandard.body: The instructions use the Agent Skills format, supported by Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI and other agents. Hooks, commands and runtime dependencies depend on the package and installer.
